import os, sys
for k in list(os.environ):
    if 'proxy' in k.lower(): del os.environ[k]
import openai, httpx
from openai.cli import _cli
seen = []
def fake_handle(self, request):
    p = self._pool
    seen.append((type(p).__name__, getattr(getattr(p, '_proxy_url', None), 'host', b''), str(request.url)))
    return httpx.Response(200, json={'object': 'list', 'data': []}, request=request)
httpx.HTTPTransport.handle_request = fake_handle  # stub network only
sys.argv = ['openai', '-p', 'https://proxy.example:3128', '-k', 'sk-test', '-b', 'https://api.example/v1', 'api', 'models.list']
_cli._main()
assert seen and seen[-1][0] == 'HTTPProxy' and b'proxy.example' in seen[-1][1], seen
print('OK request routed via CLI --proxy')
